startUrls.title: Source page(s)
startUrls.description: The web page(s) to mine for brands. Can be a listicle ('25 best men's supplement brands'), a marketplace category, a retailer stockist page, an awards list, a directory, or a single brand's own site (set Discovery mode to 'single-brand').

discoveryMode.title: Discovery mode
discoveryMode.description: How brands are extracted from the source page. 'auto' detects whether the page is a list of brands or a single brand site.
enumTitles: Single brand (the source page IS the brand)

brandLinkSelector.title: Brand link CSS selector (optional)
brandLinkSelector.description: Restrict brand-link extraction to a region of the page, e.g. '.article-body' or '#brand-grid'. Leave empty to scan the whole page with heuristic filtering.

maxBrands.title: Max brands
maxBrands.description: Maximum number of brands to profile and research.

includeDomains.title: Only these domains
includeDomains.description: If set, only brand links on these registrable domains are kept.

excludeDomains.title: Never these domains
excludeDomains.description: Extra domains to drop on top of the built-in denylist (social networks, CDNs, retailers, news sites).

profileDepth.title: Brand profiling depth
profileDepth.description: 'fast' = homepage only. 'standard' = homepage + about/product index + Shopify products.json. 'deep' = standard + up to 5 extra on-site pages.

maxProductsPerBrand.title: Max products per brand
maxProductsPerBrand.description: How many product names to keep per brand. These become Ad Library search terms when the ad search strategy includes products.

minClassificationConfidence.title: Min classification confidence
minClassificationConfidence.description: Brands scoring below this (0-100) are still reported but flagged as 'unclassified'.

customTaxonomy.title: Custom taxonomy (optional)
customTaxonomy.description: Override or extend the built-in niche taxonomy. Shape: { "niche": { "subNiche": { "terms": ["..."], "audience": ["..."] } } }. Merged over the built-in taxonomy.

adsProvider.title: Ad Library provider
adsProvider.description: Where ad data comes from. 'auto' picks the first one that is configured. See README for what each provider can and cannot return.
enumTitles: Meta Ad Library Graph API (needs access token)
Apify Ad Library actor (needs Apify token)

metaAccessToken.title: Meta Graph API access token
metaAccessToken.description: Token for the official Ad Library API (ads_archive). Required for the 'meta-graph' provider.

adsApifyActorId.title: Apify Ad Library actor ID
adsApifyActorId.description: Actor to call for ad data when using the 'apify-actor' provider, e.g. 'apify/facebook-ads-scraper'.

adsApifyActorInput.title: Extra input for the Ad Library actor
adsApifyActorInput.description: Merged into the input sent to the Ad Library actor. Use it to pass actor-specific options the mapper does not set.

adCountries.title: Ad countries
adCountries.description: ISO country codes to search the Ad Library in. EU codes are what unlock audience-reach figures.

adSearchStrategy.title: Ad search strategy
adSearchStrategy.description: What to search the Ad Library for.

adsPerBrand.title: Max ads per brand
adsPerBrand.description: How many ads to keep per brand after ranking by exposure.

adActiveStatus.title: Ad status
adActiveStatus.description: Whether to return ads that are currently running, ones that have stopped, or both. Ads that stopped after a long run are often the most informative winners.

minExposureScore.title: Minimum exposure score
minExposureScore.description: Keep only ads scoring at or above this (0-100) before analysis. Set ~60 to look only at what a brand is genuinely scaling. Note: Meta publishes true impressions for political/issue ads only, so this score is built from EU reach, days running and creative variants — read the README before treating it as an impression filter.

provenWinnerMinDays.title: Proven-winner threshold (days)
provenWinnerMinDays.description: An ad running at least this long counts as a scaled winner. Advertisers switch off what does not work, so survival is the strongest evidence available when no impression figure exists.

analyseLandingPages.title: Open and analyse landing pages
analyseLandingPages.description: Off by default because it costs extra requests. When on, the actor opens the pages the ads point at and reports their shape, headings, price, guarantee, CTA count and — most usefully — whether the page continues the angle its ads promise.

maxLandingPagesPerBrand.title: Max landing pages per brand
maxLandingPagesPerBrand.description: How many destinations to open per brand, taken in order of exposure invested behind them.

discoverPageInventory.title: Discover every published page (sitemap)
discoverPageInventory.description: Reads robots.txt and the sitemaps it declares to inventory everything the brand publishes — products, collections, advertorials, landing pages — and reports what it publishes but puts NO ad spend behind, plus ad destinations missing from the sitemap (usually deliberately unindexed funnels).

maxSitemapUrls.title: Max sitemap URLs per brand
maxSitemapUrls.description: Cap on URLs read from a brand’s sitemaps. Large catalogues are counted up to this and the report says the count is a floor.

analyseProductPages.title: Read product pages in detail
analyseProductPages.description: Opens product pages for price and compare-at price (the real discount), variants, subscription offer and its discount, bundle tiers, guarantee, review counts, trust badges and the conversion apps installed. On Shopify it reads the storefront product JSON rather than parsing markup.

maxProductPagesPerBrand.title: Max product pages per brand
maxProductPagesPerBrand.description: Product pages the ads point at are read first, then the sitemap, then the rest — spend before breadth.

analyseCheckout.title: Read cart and checkout mechanics
analyseCheckout.description: Cart style (drawer or page), currency, free-shipping threshold, payment methods, BNPL providers, checkout and post-purchase apps, plus the real returns window and shipping terms from the policy pages. The checkout page ITSELF is not fetched: it exists only behind a cart, and reaching it would mean creating a cart on the brand’s store.

rankBy.title: Rank ads by
rankBy.description: 'composite' blends every exposure signal that is actually present (impressions, EU reach, days running, creative variants, spend). Read the README: Meta only publishes true impressions for political/issue ads.

useLlm.title: Use an LLM to enrich classification & angles
useLlm.description: Off by default: the actor is fully deterministic without it. When on, an LLM refines the niche call and names the angles in plain language, on top of (never instead of) the rule-based pass.

llmApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
llmApiKey.description: Anthropic API key used for the optional enrichment pass. Falls back to the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable when empty.

llmModel.title: Model
llmModel.description: Anthropic model ID used for enrichment, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5".

outputFormats.title: Report formats
outputFormats.description: Dataset is always written. The others are saved to the key-value store as REPORT.json / REPORT.md / REPORT.html.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many brand sites are fetched in parallel. The nested Ad Library actor is capped at 3 regardless, because each call is a full actor run.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (s)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout when fetching source pages and brand sites.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times a failed page fetch is retried, with exponential backoff.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Strongly recommended. Brand sites and the Ad Library both rate-limit datacenter IPs.
